title: Canonical event, delivery and trace fabric

requirements.statement: Event producers serialize the reviewed CloudEvents 1.0 JSON envelope and reject unknown or non-compliant extension attributes.
Tenant scope is derived from authenticated execution context, immutable across delivery, and isolated for event reads, inbox receipts, retries and replay.
Domain state changes, event records and outbox records are committed atomically in one database transaction.
Outbox claiming uses expiring owner-bound leases; stale or cross-tenant acknowledgements fail closed.
Consumers atomically commit inbox deduplication and business effects before acknowledgement; duplicate delivery is expected and idempotently handled.
Retries are bounded, exponential and jittered; poison events dead-letter and explicit replay is tenant-scoped and audited.
Event payloads are untrusted data and never grant or alter execution authority.
W3C trace and correlation identifiers are validated and preserved across supported event boundaries.
Ordering is not guaranteed by the base outbox. Any adapter advertising per-aggregate order must enforce head-of-line blocking and pass cross-worker retry/replay tests.
Actual Platform, SDK and OS event payloads validate against the exact TSIC schema revision pinned by the candidate ecosystem lock.
